newSub: The code is assigned on first save. Every field is required for review; a draft can be incomplete.
subtitle: Grade {grade} · {cluster} · Author: {author}

done.approved: Item approved — it can now fill scored positions and be designated an anchor.
done.retired: Item retired. Frozen forms keep the version they froze.
done.newVersion: Opened the v{n} draft. The previous version stays frozen.

retireDlg.title: Retire {code}?
retireDlg.body: The item will no longer go into new forms. Frozen forms and statistics stay as they are. This can’t be undone.

card.title: Item card
card.topicNone: No topics for this grade and cluster — choose another cluster.
card.skillHint: Grades 0–2 are measured by skill, so a skill is required.
card.skillNone: This topic has no skills for this grade — choose another topic.
card.phConstruct: What does a correct answer show? e.g. finds a fraction of a quantity
card.expectedHint: Expected p is your forecast of the share of children who answer correctly. After the pilot, items outside 0.20–0.85 go back to the author.
card.eExpected: Expected p: enter a number between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.45.
card.locked: Grade, topic, skill and construct lock after the first submission: statistics and forms refer to the item exactly as it was.

stem.title: Stem
stem.youngWarn: Children in grades 0–1 don’t read fluently yet, so the instruction is read aloud. Choose “Picture + read-aloud audio” — the audio is required.
stem.ph: Write the question exactly as the child will see it. Grades 0–1: keep it almost text-free — it is read aloud.

media.imgSub: PNG, JPEG or SVG, up to 2 MB
media.audSub: Required · MP3 up to 3 MB, uz and ru
media.eType: This file type won’t work: pictures must be PNG, JPEG or SVG, audio must be MP3.
media.eSize: The file is too large: pictures up to 2 MB, audio up to 3 MB.
media.eEmpty: The file is empty — choose another one.
media.eFailed: We couldn’t upload the file. Try again.

opt.title: Answer options
opt.hint: Mark the correct answer. Every distractor needs an error type and a rationale — that’s what makes the report diagnostic.
opt.phRat: Which mistake leads a child here? e.g. divides by 2 instead of 3
opt.eRat: Explain why a child would pick this

keysHidden.title: The key is hidden
keysHidden.body: You are reviewing this item: solve it blind first. The correct answer, error types and rationales are revealed in the review flow.

sum.title: Fix before submitting · {n}
sum.body: Nothing has been sent. Fields that need attention are marked in red below.
sum.fixed: All fixed — you can submit it for review now.

sent.title: Sent for review
sent.body: A reviewer first solves the item blind, then sees the key and rationales and gives a verdict. If their answer disagrees with your key, the item is rejected automatically. You’re paid once it’s accepted.

frozen.title: You’re viewing v{n} — it’s frozen
frozen.body: Frozen versions can’t be edited — create a new version (new calibration). v{n} and its statistics stay exactly as they are.
frozen.inReview: This version is in review and frozen. The verdict will appear here, in the version history.

save.savedSub: {time} · reviewers won’t see it until you submit.
save.errBody: The connection dropped. Your edits are kept on this device — nothing is lost. Try again once you’re back online.
save.restored: Your unsaved edits were restored from this device.
save.leave: You have unsaved changes. If you leave, they stay only on this device. Leave the page?

hist.title: Version history
hist.note: Each version is a separate item for the scale. Even a fixed comma means a new version and a new calibration.
hist.blindWrong: The reviewer picked a different answer

cal.title: Calibration · v{n}
cal.emptyBody: First the item collects them as an unscored pretest item in live forms (4–5 in every form) — only then can it count toward results.
cal.distNote: A distractor almost nobody picks (under 5%) gets flagged: the item is then easier than it looks.

role.title: Role in forms
role.hSub: Identical in every wave of this grade — makes October comparable to December
role.vSub: Shared with the grade above — links grades on one scale
role.linkHint: Should be solved by about 20–30% of grade {g} and 60%+ of grade {h}.
role.top: Grade 4 is the top of the scale and has no vertical anchors.
role.warn: Anchors never go into practice and are never shown in the post-test review — not even the correct answer. One leak into a parents’ chat and the next wave is no longer comparable.
role.onlyEditor: Only the bank editor designates anchors, and only on approved items.

pay.title: Authors are paid per accepted item
pay.body: Not per submitted one. Accepted means it passed review: a reviewer solves it blind, then critiques it. 30–40% of items are rejected — that’s normal.

errors.topic_grade: This topic doesn’t cover the chosen grade.
errors.skill_topic: This skill doesn’t belong to the chosen topic.
errors.topic_unknown: That topic doesn’t exist — reload the page.
errors.unknown_media: One of the files wasn’t found — upload it again.
errors.too_many_options: An item can’t have more than 5 options.
errors.not_draft: The item is no longer a draft — the page was refreshed.
errors.frozen: This version is already frozen — the page was refreshed.
errors.item_fields_locked: Grade, topic and skill can’t change after the first submission.
errors.cannot_version: A new version can’t be created now: the item is in review or retired.
errors.draft_exists: An open draft already exists — your changes go there.
errors.not_accepted: Only an accepted item can be approved.
errors.not_approved: Only an approved item can be an anchor.
errors.anchor_in_frozen_form: This anchor sits in a frozen form — it can’t be removed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission for this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Item not found — it was removed or isn’t yours.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Try again once you’re back online.

states.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to this section
states.noAccessBody: Writing and editing items is for item authors and the bank editor. Ask an administrator for the role if you need it.
states.noAccessViewBody: The item bank is for item authors, reviewers and the bank editor. Ask an administrator for a role if you need it.
states.notFoundBody: There is no such item, or it isn’t yours: authors see only their own items.
states.errTitle: We couldn’t load the item card
states.errBody: The server didn’t answer. Edits kept on this device are not lost. Try again.
